title: Cache Stampede Prevention Pattern — Runnable Simulations
title_es: Patrón Cache Stampede Prevention — Simulaciones ejecutables
description: Runnable cache stampede simulator in Python and TypeScript: 20 concurrent callers on an expired hot key, comparing naive cache-aside against single-flight, distributed lock and stale-while-revalidate. Stdlib only.
description_es: Simulador ejecutable de cache stampede en Python y TypeScript: 20 llamadores concurrentes sobre una key caliente expirada, comparando cache-aside ingenuo contra single-flight, lock distribuido y stale-while-revalidate. Solo stdlib.
